                                    MF / AE Grain Policy
Transactions during CBOT electronic trading hours (including overnight).
Payment on grain sold will be available on the 1st business day after sale.
Purchased grain is due upon receipt of invoice.
Price Later / Storage Fees will be billed each quarter – date TBD.

INBOUND GRAIN (all classes)                          Moisture          AE        Test Weight            F.M.        Damage
Corn                                                  15.0 %        **16 %         * 54.0 #’s            3.0 %         5.0 %
Soybeans                                              13.0 %                         54.0 #’s            1.0 %         2.0 %
                     *Test Weight Requirement on Corn over 20% Moisture adjusted down .25#’s per Point of Moisture
                     * AE no load averaging. Corn up to 16% with no moisture discount, then 4 cents/point prorated.
Discount Schedules - We reserve the right to reject any loads that do not meet our grade or specifications.

Custom Drying
In and out within 10 days – regular drying and shrink discount + $.15 / bu. handling charge.
Drying of corn will be based on the difference of incoming moisture of corn and the outgoing moisture (no guarantees).
